## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] The golden outputs are byte-identical, or re-recorded with `npm run sim:golden` and the
      commit message says why they moved.
- [ ] Where a later reader might reverse this without knowing why, a decision record is added in
      `docs/decisions/` and its row in the index.
